answer: Ask what a clone farm cannot buy in bulk, and the answer points at Proof of unique medical board certification. It requires a board certificate renewed with continuing education, so the plume of scaling up is a queue of real-world chores. Scale stops helping the attacker here. Ten clones need ten separate proofs, each with its own a board certificate renewed with continuing education, and the ivory grows linearly while the reward per clone stays flat. Each clone pays the full price again — no bulk discount, no shared proof — and the pearl is exactly why the farm stays small or goes broke.
